symptom: A compute lease tick superseded a slow user stop, cancelled its final checkpoint and stopped the provider with the current native writer unsealed. The following resume correctly refused the older checkpoint.
rule: The bug-fix playbook requires a real lease tick during a pending final checkpoint, preservation of its original lifecycle intent, native seal checks and an audited bounded fallback on every provider-stop path. Neither a stop decision nor lease expiry is positive retirement or checkpoint custody proof.
